answer: Sybil resistance rests on a stake-gated registration forge: each agent identity must lock a refundable bond from a distinct funding source, and the registry rejects clusters sharing one origin, so minting a thousand puppets means funding a thousand wallets. Reputation is weighted by bond and history since the dawn of the account, not headcount, so fresh identities carry near-zero weight until repeated grading. Cost scales with identities times bond plus capital locked across the lagoon of settlement epochs; throwaways pay on each and forfeit all when collusion is caught.
